title: Validity of the Single Processor Approach to Achieving Large Scale Computing Capabilities
publisher: AFIPS Conference Proceedings (Spring Joint Computer Conference)
annotation: Makalah dasar klasik yang merumuskan Hukum Amdahl mengenai batas peningkatan kinerja sistem komputasi paralel dan terdistribusi.

title: Computer Architecture: A Quantitative Approach
authors: John L. Hennessy, David A. Patterson
annotation: Buku teks standar emas arsitektur komputer yang mengulas prinsip-prinsip evaluasi kuantitatif performa, hierarki memori, dan teknik profiling sistem komputasi modern.

title: High Performance Browser Networking
